Blocks.description: The five close blocks under fixed keys, then the six optional open blocks (the writer sorts keys; ``in_order`` is the board order).
Blocks.title: Blocks

CountFigure.description: A count of things (opportunities, groups), whole and not negative.
CountFigure.title: CountFigure

Gap.description: A named data gap, used in place of a figure that cannot be computed. Never a zero.
Gap.title: Gap

IndexLevelFigure.description:
The level of a published market index in index points as its publisher states it (a Cboe
volatility index: 18.20 is 18.20 points). Not the 0 to 100 ease scale of ``IndexPointsFigure``:
the level has no upper bound in practice, the cap here only rejects a corrupt value.
IndexLevelFigure.title: IndexLevelFigure

MarketLine.description: 市场一行: one sentence and up to six figures.
MarketLine.title: MarketLine

MoneyCell.description: A money cell with a currency and, for JPY, an optional display-only ``approx_usd``.
MoneyCell.title: MoneyCell

PercentagePointsFigure.description: A difference of two percents, signed.
PercentagePointsFigure.title: PercentagePointsFigure

Reminders.description: 持仓提醒: the groups to look at (``rows``) and, folded below, the calm rest as a table.
Reminders.title: Reminders

RestRow.description:
One calm group of the folded rest table: five cells in the order of ``Reminders.rest_columns``
(标的, 组合, 户, 到期, 已赚); a value that is not stored is a ``Gap``, never 0 or empty.
RestRow.title: RestRow

SharePercentFigure.description: A share in whole percent, 0 to 100.
SharePercentFigure.title: SharePercentFigure

StaleLabel.description: Python sends the times and the label; the browser only compares its clock with ``stale_after``.
StaleLabel.title: StaleLabel

StatusLine.description: One line of a folded 系统状态 list (the page's, and the ``SystemStatus`` block's).
StatusLine.title: StatusLine

SystemStatus.description: 系统状态, collapsible (``collapsed`` is the initial state).
SystemStatus.title: SystemStatus

Tiles.description: The four tiles of the board, in board order.
Tiles.title: Tiles

UsdFigure.description: A displayed US-dollar amount (two decimals in ``value``, whole dollars in ``text``).
UsdFigure.title: UsdFigure

UsdSignedFigure.description: A signed US-dollar amount; ``text`` starts with ``+`` or ``−`` (U+2212).
UsdSignedFigure.title: UsdSignedFigure

WatchRow.description: A 待定/看名单 row: a name that is not a candidate yet, with the reason in ``text``.
WatchRow.title: WatchRow

option_trader__viewmodels__report_open__.description: 候选: sector groups, at most one covered call and one put spread.
option_trader__viewmodels__report_open__.title: Candidates

option_trader__viewmodels__report_open__.description: An account meter: ``percent`` is the share of the account's limit used, whole percent.
option_trader__viewmodels__report_open__.title: Meter
